description: Ask Toll a plain-language question about Robinhood Chain (a coin, a dev wallet, a wallet's approvals or privacy, a smart account, a v4 hook, an ERC-8004 agent, paid x402 APIs, the chain right now, a stock token). Toll's AI picks which of Toll's own read tools to run (at most 4), runs them, and answers in a few plain sentences naming the tool each fact came from; every number, verdict and address in the answer is checked against the tool results, and when the check fails the raw tool results come back instead. Nothing from outside Toll's tools. 500 characters at most; address optional. 3 questions a day free, 30 with a $TOLL holder's key. Facts, not advice.

address.description: Optional: the address the question is about (a coin, a wallet, a hook or an account on Robinhood Chain): 0x followed by 40 hex characters

question.description: Your question in plain words, up to 500 characters
